question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.

I am in a hurry so I will see you __tomorow__.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tomorow"** is the incorrect spelling of "tomorrow". It refers to the day after today. (कल)

 
 
• **Example: **I am in a hurry so I will see you tomorow.
 
 
 
• **"Tomorrow"** is the correct spelling. It refers to the day following the present day. (कल)
 
 
• **Example: **I have a meeting scheduled for tomorrow.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is: **'tomorrow'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **tomoorrow** (टूमॉर्रो): This is an incorrect spelling of** "tomorrow"**.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: I will meet you tomoorrow.
 
 
 
• **tomoorow** (टूमॉरो): This is an incorrect spelling of "tomorrow".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Let's plan for tomoorow.
 
 
 
• **toomorow** (टूमोरो): This is an incorrect spelling of "tomorrow".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: The event is scheduled for toomorow.
